text:
morgan: Quick sync — we need to pick a consistent client-facing mapping for routing/fallback/quota cases. Current behavior: some fallbacks are 200 with warnings, others return 500. Confusing for integrators.

srinivas: We historically returned 503 for capacity and 429 for quotas but a handful of internal code paths bubbled up 500s. I agree we should tighten.

ellie: Proposal: three surface classes:
- retryable_transient -> 503 + Retry-After header
- rate_limited -> 429 + X-RateLimit-* headers
- user_error/permanent -> 4xx (400/403) with actionable message

jamie: Also: intentional fallback to lower-tier model should NOT be an error. Return 200 with a warning metadata field and explicit model_used. Clients can decide whether to surface to users.

srinivas: Example shapes (RFC):
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Retry-After: 30
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "error": {
    "type": "transient_capacity",
    "code": "capacity_unavailable",
    "message": "Capacity temporarily unavailable in region us-west-2",
    "retry_after": 30
  }
}
```

and for fallback:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Model-Fallback: redwood-medium

{
  "model_used": "redwood-medium",
  "warning": ["fallback_due_to_capacity"],
  "output": "..."
}
```

ellie: Headers we should standardize: X-Redwood-Model-Fallback, X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.

morgan: Important: don't expose internal routing policy names (e.g., 'spot_pool_eviction'). Use generic reasons (capacity, degraded_quality, rate_limit).

jamie: Console UX: surface model_used and warning counts on the request row. Add filter for 'requests with fallback' in the Diagnostics tab.

srinivas: Rollout plan: feature-flag the API change, open beta for a week for clients that opt in, then grad rollout. We need SDK changes for automatic retry using Retry-After header.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled -> staging at 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z, prod gradual rollout next week if no regressions :rocket:

ellie: I'll draft the docs + example retry snippet. Will ping #docs when ready.

morgan: Cool. Action items: (1) eng-platform implement header + error shape (srinivas), (2) console show fallback metrics (jamie), (3) docs + SDK examples (ellie). Back to you all after PRs.
